kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انحسمت (form VII)
# اِنْحَسَمْتُ (inḥasamtu) /in.ħa.sam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# اِنْحَسَمْتَ (inḥasamta) /in.ħa.sam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# اِنْحَسَمْتِ (inḥasamti) /in.ħa.sam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# اِنْحَسَمَتْ (inḥasamat) /in.ħa.sa.mat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
